bugs.what: Item list sometimes silently drops consumables (e.g. 'dried herbs' vanished from inventory after an unrelated 'use bitter forest bark' action without a clear consumption message tied to it)
Menu numbering shifts turn-to-turn as new options/items appear, so a remembered menu number can silently map to a different action next turn if not re-read carefully

confusions: Early on it's unclear that 'weigh what this grief asks (free)' exists at every grief-site and reveals all resolution paths — I discovered this pattern late and could have used it more systematically from the start
The relationship between 'promise the reeve' and 'ask the priest's blessing' (order matters, but only revealed via an NPC hint at the inn) wasn't signposted in the quest text itself

It's not obvious until deep into Act 2 that crossing into Coldpass/Marrowgate permanently locks out unfinished companion quests (Tamsin's mine grief never got closed) — the warning appears only at the Pass Gate itself, one step before the point of no return
Numeric evidence puzzles (mere-stone vs ring-ditch vs causeway for 'Which King') gave conflicting answers 2-vs-1 with no in-fiction confirmation of which was authoritative until the naming succeeded
suggestions: Surface the 'weigh what this grief asks' free hint automatically the first time a player enters any grief-location, rather than requiring them to discover the menu option
Add an earlier, softer warning (e.g. at the first companion recruitment) that companion personal quests must be resolved before crossing into Act 3, not just at the final gate
Let 'status' flag which open quests will become permanently unavailable soon, not just list them as open
Consider a brief recap of who said what evidence when multiple conflicting clues feed one decision, so the player isn't relying purely on memory of scattered dialogue
